test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

This class used to be very noisy, but it was unusually ______ today.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. '****subdued'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **given sentence is talking about a noisy classroom which is unusually not noisy today.**
 
• Therefore, **the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is '****subdued'.**
 
• The word** ****'****subdued****'**** **means not strong.
 
 
• Example: *Because of his **subdued** voice, it seemed he is upset today.*
 
 
 
• Hence,** **the correct answer is **option 2.**

 

**Complete Sentence:**__ *This class used to be very noisy, but it was unusually **__subdued__** today.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
